sample.question:
You may add exactly one mirror to an empty cell. Which option makes the laser hit a target instead of its original terminal result?
Options:
[1] place / at (1, 7)
[2] place / at (1, 1)
[3] place / at (1, 5)
[4] place \ at (1, 2)
[5] place / at (1, 4)
[6] place / at (2, 2)
sample.analysis:
Testing option 2, adding / at (1, 1) changes the path as follows:
Cell (2, 1): mirror / turns right to up.
Cell (1, 1): mirror / turns up to right.
Cell (1, 2): empty.
Cell (1, 3): hit target B.
The beam reaches target B, so choose option 2.

state_content.rules: A laser starts outside the grid and travels cell by cell. '/' and '\' mirrors reflect it; stone blocks absorb it; targets are hit when the beam enters their cell.
